summary: End-to-end testing of the new Universal CSV Cleaner feature (AI suggests, R proves) plus regression of the sleep-wellbeing R dashboard. Backend: 6/6 new pytest tests pass against public URL — /api/clean/profile returns correct n_rows=10, n_cols=8, duplicate_rows>=1 and per-column {name,inferred_type,n_missing,n_distinct,sample,labels}; /api/clean/suggest returns {rules, source} with source='ai' and at least one categorical label_map; /api/clean/apply returns rows_before=10, rows_after<=9 (duplicate removed), full audit list, cleaned CSV with snake_cased headers, and a reproducible R script. Invalid rules JSON correctly returns 400; empty file returns 400/500. Previous regression suite (test_r_pipeline.py, 10 tests) still 100% green. Frontend: Playwright flow against production URL passed every step — uploading sample_messy.csv shows csv-profile-block ('10 rows'), 'Get AI cleaning suggestions' shows rules-review-block with rules-source-badge='AI-suggested', toggle-clean-names / toggle-remove-dupes / rule-include-* / rule-type-* all respond, 'Apply cleaning in R' renders clean-result-block with audit-table (normalize_labels on City=7, Plan=5, Satisfaction=7; coerce_numeric on Age=2; remove_duplicate_rows=1), cleaned-preview-table with snake_cased columns (id, full_name, city, age, signup_date, plan, monthly_spend, satisfaction) and NYC/new york merged to 'New York', LA/los angeles merged to 'Los Angeles', good/GOOD normalized, generated-script (~8KB of real R code) rendered, all three downloads (download-cleaned-csv/-r-script/-audit) visible and clickable. Regression tids for the sleep dashboard (run-r-pipeline-button, run-tests-button, figures-gallery-grid) still render below the cleaner.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/clean/apply uses tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile with delete=False and os.unlink in finally — correct, no leak on error. Good.
_decode_csv enforces a 15 MB cap and errors='replace' for non-UTF-8 bytes — reasonable, but silently masking decode errors could hide bad data; consider surfacing a warning.

LLM path swallows all exceptions and falls back silently to deterministic rules (source='fallback'). Behaviour matches the spec but means transient LLM outages are invisible to users; a soft note in the UI badge tooltip would help.

_parse_rules_json tolerates markdown fences / stray text — robust. Still, no JSON-schema validation on columns array keys; a malformed rules object from the LLM would bubble into R and surface as 500. Low risk given deterministic fallback.
No rate limiting on /api/clean/* — not critical for an academic demo but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Not required — sample_messy.csv is already shipped at /app/frontend/public/sample_messy.csv and served at /sample_messy.csv.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CSV cleaner regression lives at /app/backend/tests/test_csv_cleaner.py (uses the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and the sample CSV on disk). /api/clean/apply needs BOTH multipart 'file' and form 'rules' (JSON string). /api/clean/suggest can take 5-20s (LLM) — use >=60s timeout. Frontend testids verified: csv-cleaner-section, csv-file-input, csv-upload-button, csv-filename, csv-profile-block, profile-rows, get-ai-suggestions-button, rules-review-block, rules-source-badge, toggle-clean-names, toggle-remove-dupes, rule-row-<col>, rule-include-<col>, rule-type-<col>, apply-cleaning-button, clean-result-block, audit-table, cleaned-preview-table, generated-script, download-cleaned-csv, download-r-script, download-audit, cleaner-error.
